description: Copy the Spark-style site files that are live on a domain (index.html, other pages, styles.css) into an Object Storage bucket folder, as a backup or to keep editing from there. Replaces same-named files in that folder. Needs confirm: true.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the customer has explicitly confirmed this exact change.

storage_service_id.description: Object Storage service id, as returned by the matching list tool.
